predictions.mechanism: A new Iranian restricted zone and conditional Hormuz opening raise the probability of renewed shipping disruption and geopolitical risk premia, supporting safe-haven demand for gold.
predictions.invalidation: Iran and Oman finalize a credible open corridor with materially improved tanker traffic and no further military escalation.

predictions.mechanism: Silver receives some safe-haven and softer-dollar support, but industrial-demand sensitivity makes the geopolitical impulse less clean than for gold.
predictions.invalidation: Risk premia fade quickly, the dollar rebounds materially, or broader growth fears overwhelm precious-metal support.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil and renewed Hormuz shipping risk raise energy-cost and inflation pressure on Germany's energy-sensitive industrial economy.
predictions.invalidation: Brent falls sharply as shipping normalizes or a credible de-escalation agreement is announced.

predictions.mechanism: A higher oil-risk premium and geopolitical uncertainty weigh on euro-area cyclicals and increase the chance of tighter financial conditions.
predictions.invalidation: Hormuz transit normalizes and oil gives back the risk premium.

predictions.mechanism: France is less energy-intensive than Germany but remains exposed to European risk-off sentiment and higher imported energy costs.
predictions.invalidation: European risk sentiment improves materially alongside lower oil prices.

predictions.mechanism: Japan is a major energy importer, so a sustained Hormuz premium worsens input costs while geopolitical risk can pressure exporters and cyclicals.
predictions.invalidation: Oil prices retreat and regional risk sentiment recovers decisively.
